Q-6546: What is the largest prime number less than 253?

Answer: 251

253 = 11 × 23 (not prime)
252 is even (not prime)
251: check divisibility by primes up to √251 ≈ 15.8 (3, 5, 7, 11, 13) — none divide evenly, so 251 is prime.

Largest prime less than 253 is 251.
